text:
Maria Chen: Quick thread to finalize May webinar format - working title: ‘Practical Inference Playbook’. Audience = platform engineers. Prefer actionable + demos.
Alex Park: Proposed split: 12m customer story / 15m ops playbook / 20m hands-on lab / 10m live Q&A. 57m total.
Priya Singh: Need two short abstracts and one-line CTAs for registration page. I can draft.
Jonah Lee: Benchmarks: I'll run median p50/p95 + $/1M tokens for baseline vs optimized. Need prompt list from Priya.
Priya Singh: Dropping 6 prompts into the shared doc: short chat, long summary, search, code complete, instruction-follow, multi-turn.
Samir Patel: Ops playbook topics: batching, KV cache warmup, model routing, autoscaler config. Will include CLI snippet.
Carla Gomez: Customer case confirmed (Acme). I can do live demo + 60s fallback recording.
Maria Chen: Draft run-of-show: 
```
0:00 Intro & goals (Maria) - 5m
0:05 Customer story (Carla) - 12m
0:17 Ops playbook (Samir) - 15m
0:32 Hands-on lab (Alex/Samir) - 20m
0:52 Live Q&A + poll - 10m
1:02 Close & CTAs (Maria) - 3m
```
Alex Park: Rehearsal plan: May 28 full run (45-60m). Tech-check May 30 (mic + recording). @calendar-bot please create both.
calendar-bot: Events created: "May 28 Full Rehearsal" and "May 30 Tech Check". Recording enabled.
Priya Singh: Inbound form fields (required): company, email, company size, primary use-case, expected monthly tokens, preferred deployment. Routing rules: <100k -> SDR A, 100k-5M -> SDR B, >5M -> AE. Samir to implement.
Samir Patel: Will wire the form and add a hidden field for demo preference (cheap vs fidelity). Will share test link by EOD Friday.
Jonah Lee: I'll post bench numbers and attach the CSV to the shared folder tomorrow AM.
Maria Chen: Backup plan: every live demo has a recorded fallback and a pre-seeded lab dataset. Samir please prepare pre-seeded responses + swap checklist.
Samir Patel: On it. Prep runbook and response set.
Maria Chen: Final ask: speakers, please upload 2-paragraph bio + headshot by May 20. Locking run-of-show unless objections. :rocket:
